svg.title: Two mirrors: a tunnel that bends, exact closure, and collapse
svg.desc: Top row: the view into the upper of two round mirrors, where each ring is the rim of a mirror reflected once more. Parallel mirrors give a straight tunnel; tilting them by 3.5 or 8 degrees bends it, more for the larger angle. Bottom row, seen from above: at 8 degrees the reflections lie on a gently curving line; at 60 degrees, 180 over 3, they close up into a kaleidoscope of five; as the distance between the mirrors shrinks, all reflections converge on one point.
